parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- `zh` (default): Chinese

- `en`: English

parameters.name: GatewayId
parameters.description: The gateway ID. Specify this parameter or `GatewayUniqueId`.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique gateway ID. Specify this parameter or `GatewayId`. If both are specified, `GatewayUniqueId` takes precedence.
